claims.statement: Management targets maintaining gross margins in the ballpark of 14% to 15%.
claims.quote: if it is in that ballpark 14% to 15% type of a range, we will pass that on to customers.

claims.statement: The current store expansion rate is the appropriate number for the foreseeable future.
claims.quote: our view at this point of time, Ashish, is that, you know, this is the right number at this point in time, at least in the foreseeable future.

claims.statement: Efficiency gains from network consolidation in DMart Ready are expected to reflect in FY27 and onwards.
claims.quote: This would probably reflect in efficiency gains in FY27 and onwards, I presume.

facts.statement: Total organized trade, including quick commerce, e-commerce, and modern retail, is estimated to be in the early teens.
facts.quote: total organized trade including quick commerce and e-commerce still is roughly in the early teens.

facts.statement: Out of 85 stores opened in the last fiscal year, 15 were leased.
facts.quote: Of the 85 stores that we opened last fiscal, 15 were leased.

facts.statement: The company currently operates 68 leased stores out of over 500 total stores.
facts.quote: about 68 stores out of the 500 plus stores that we have now. We have 68 stores which are on lease.

facts.statement: DMart Ready currently has 165 pickup points.
